title: hydrocotyle homalocarpa
intro: Hydrocotyle homalocarpa, commonly known as Leptandra, is a plant species within the family Hydrocotylaceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues, such as constipation and dyspepsia, due to its soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hydrocotyle homalocarpa include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve nausea, while also serving as a natural laxative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
